items.title: Edgar Mosley Interview, 1958-09-03
items.q: by me and him being good friends, he took me on a little job where he could get by with me. And then after he got me down

ctx.x: Well, he'd been playing drums, hadn't he?

He had been playing drums, yeah. Yeah, and he tried to like me. And by me and him being good friends, he took me on a little job where he could get by with me. And then after he got me down, I'd come and say, be good on the drums, good as the bank fella. I played all the job he played. Plum up, tell the last of 43 when I left and came up here.
That's what I wanted to check on. You came out here late in 1943.

items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: I'm the one who started it on the drums. He used to play the bass drum in the band, and I helped him a lot with the traps.

ctx.x: What about Edgar Mosley? You talk a lot about that. Did you work much with Edgar?
It was the main band. It played, I'm the one who started it on the drums. He used to play the bass drum in the band, and I helped him a lot with the traps. I see.
So you did a little teaching of?
